blocks.text: Hot-air balloon flight and flight to Cartagena

provenance.rationale: Extract the corresponding destination or service label from the verified Word paragraph.

blocks.text:
Departure is planned for around 5 am. The day begins with a hot-air balloon flight over the coffee valley.

At dawn, plantations, eucalyptus trees, dirt roads and small haciendas gradually come into view below the balloon. Mist rises between the green hills as sunlight slowly reaches the slopes of the Andes.

A second breakfast is planned after the flight. **It is not included in the price.**

The canopy activity and horseback ride today are included in the tour price. The route takes you between suspended platforms and zip lines above the green slopes.

You will then explore the coffee valley on horseback. The trail follows plantations, bamboo groves and small farms, with views of the Andes from the higher sections.

After the activities, transfer to the airport for your flight to Cartagena. On arrival, you will be taken to **Sofitel Legend Santa Clara**.

blocks.text: Cartagena: the Old Town, San Felipe and La Popa

provenance.rationale: Extract the corresponding destination or service label from the verified Word paragraph.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, your tour of Cartagena begins.

The route first takes you through Bocagrande, Castillogrande and Manga, before you head up La Popa hill. From the viewpoint, you can see the harbour, red rooftops and the old port. The 17th-century Santa Cruz monastery stands here, with its image of Our Lady of Candelaria.

The next major stop is San Felipe de Barajas fortress, the largest defensive structure built by the Spanish in the Americas.

You then follow the bastions and walls of the UNESCO-listed historic centre. You will also visit the neighbourhoods of Bocagrande, Castillogrande and Getsemaní.

Another stop is Las Bóvedas, or 'The Vaults'. Originally used to store ammunition, these spaces now sell souvenirs, jewellery, hammocks and paintings.

The tour ends with a return to your hotel along Santander Avenue, with views of the bastions and walls of the old town.
